Pair 100 · image-only velocity · top 1 cm · arrows 4× pair displacement
Image-only estimates. Cyan = inferred local surface; orange = 1 cm below it. Both panels use the same arrow scale.
Physical units assume DX in metres/pixel and DT in seconds. Height is relative to the median surface ordinate in each image.
